page.content:
Deepest known spot in the Mariana Trench, named for HMS Challenger.

How Challenger Deep connects

  • Location: Mariana Trench — Challenger Deep is the deepest surveyed point of the Mariana Trench.
  • Item: HMS Challenger — Challenger Deep is named for the ship that first sounded the Mariana Trench.

What is Challenger Deep?

Challenger Deep was first sounded on the 1875 Challenger station and later measured by bathyscaphs and modern mapping at nearly eleven kilometers.

Key threads lead to Mariana Trench and HMS Challenger.
